approval_basis: critical autonomous visual review explicitly approved and authorized by the user

source_contract.scenario_provenance: deterministic Lab-only viewer/owner/era/resource augmentation over unchanged authoritative BIQ terrain

coverage: all eight stable Civ III goody-hut buckets mapped to three source variants plus viewer-hidden suppression
all four colony owner eras, all four owners, extraterritorial ownership, preindustrial and strict industrial source families
same-tile land-resource coexistence, flat and relief adjacency, routes, rivers, vegetation, shores, and wrap-rich viewport
noon, midnight, complete, no-object, terrain+resource+object isolation, native, and reduced controls

ownership_intent.authoritative_state: Civ III viewer-conditioned hut presence plus colony owner, owner era, extraterritorial coordinates, visibility, environment, and visible-scene state
ownership_intent.retained_layers: resource bodies, labels, units, cities, borders, fog, HUD, and UI

cache_inputs: canonical tile identity, screen occurrence, viewer, and goody-hut visibility bit
colony presence, owner ID, owner era, effective owner color, territory owner, same-tile resource identity and bounds
terrain-fit transform, visibility, hour, season, and asset-definition revision
update_mode: static except when authoritative viewer, hut, colony, owner, era, resource, environment, or visible-scene state changes
fallback: After I19A, unresolved or failed custom goody-hut or colony rendering fails the custom frame visibly; it never reveals a hidden hut, duplicates a resource, or replays native object pixels.
